001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.plog;
002
003public class OfficerSkillGainRecord {
004
005        protected String personId;
006        protected String skillId;
007        protected boolean elite;
008        
009        public OfficerSkillGainRecord(String personId, String skillId, boolean elite) {
010                this.personId = personId;
011                this.skillId = skillId;
012                this.elite = elite;
013        }
014
015        public String getPersonId() {
016                return personId;
017        }
018
019        public void setPersonId(String personId) {
020                this.personId = personId;
021        }
022
023        public String getSkillId() {
024                return skillId;
025        }
026
027        public void setSkillId(String skillId) {
028                this.skillId = skillId;
029        }
030
031        public boolean isElite() {

033        }
034
035        public void setElite(boolean elite) {

037        }
038        
039
040        
041        
042}
